According to legend, Lord Lutgardis was deep in prayer when a tree, weighed down by its heavy petrified limbs, finally gave way and crashed to the forest floor. It missed Lord Lutgardis by mere inches and was immediately declared a sign from the gods that this was a blessed place to all members of [[House Lutgardis]]. }} ==Getting there== [[Lutgardis Conservatory]] is located in the southeast corner of [[Ferndale]].
